am going through a health scare. I was in for an appointment with a junior doctor who was very thorough, listened to me, took notes, asked for advice from another GP, gave me advice and referred me to a specialist clinic. The next day I got a call from the Mount Florida Medical Centre to ask me to come in the day after for an appointment with Dr. Stout who read the notes and wanted me in. He was reassuring but explained to me that he still wants me to have a call with the specialist clinic and requested an urgent thorough blood test for me which I had blood taken for the next day. Once they had the test results in, he called me. The specialist clinic evaluated the notes and they didn't think they need to talk to me, but Dr. Stout insisted they should. So I'll have the call today.

I wanted to write a detailed review because I feel I am being treated with care and my symptoms are being taken seriously and this has always been the case here.

One of the receptionists was very kind and apologetic when I called to get my blood test results and they got delayed by one day. Another receptionist was quite short, but that doesn't really influence how I feel about the care I'm
